proof_summary: The proof inducts through a signed base-$b$ representation while tracking a borrow in $\{-1,0\}$: stripping the lowest coefficient, the six coefficient/borrow cases produce a digit in $\{0,1,b-2,b-1\}$ and a quotient of the same form. If the original sum is negative, all coefficients are negated so the argument applies to its absolute value.
